en: I was afraid I'd be a bother, but I was nearby,
so I thought I'd stop in and say hello.
Foreigner or not, I'll not let it slide.
Yes, I'll be careful from now on. Goodbye.
and the British Empire's glory has faded.
note: continues #1386 (slice 017), which must end in a comma

en: Deplorable...
...Back again, are you?
Might I ask you to answer a questionnaire?
Have you foreigners no pride at all?
I suppose not.
note: answers his own question in #1448; a pause follows

en: That is why our British Empire must rule
over the world.
If only to spare the world more wretched foreigners.
How may I serve you
I feel sort of sluggish
I can't recall the nights, and I'm sleepy all day.
I await your orders
Getting up in the morning is hard.
I seem to feel better at night.
Ah, good day! A fine morning, isn't it?
Hm? You look a little pale, sir.
Ah, perhaps I do.
I'm embarrassed to say it, but I'm short on sleep.
Ha ha ha, that happens to us all.
I was always up late when I was young, too.
Mind you, a bit more sleep always fixed it.
Oops, I'd better be off to work.
What sort of work do you do?
I'm Luke. I work at the employment agency.
Jobs are scarce lately, so it's hard going.
I see. That must be hard.
note: also Nick, msg 189106 (working far from family)

en: I'll take my leave now.
If only everyone in town could enjoy their work...
Good morning. How are you today?
You look a bit better. That's good to see.
Off to work now?
I'm on my way to work myself.
Things have got busy again lately.
Well, so long. Let's both keep at it.
Ah, good evening. You look tired.
On your way home from work?
Yes, something like that.
I've been walking all day.
I see. Well, you've earned your rest.
Still, work gives life meaning, doesn't it?
I work at the employment agency, and the
city is full of poor people who want work
but can't find any, after all.
So it seems. Things must be difficult.
You're quite right.
My name's Luke. If you're ever looking for
new work, do come by the agency.
Ah, good evening. Lovely night, isn't it?
Another long day at work for you, I expect.
I did some good work today myself.
I found a job for someone in need.
Let's both keep it up. Good night, then.
Ah, how have you been?
Is your work going well?
<Well enough>
<Truth is, I've no job>
Glad to hear it. That's good.
Do keep working, and look after your health.
Oh, forgive me. I didn't realize.
I'm sorry, I just assumed you had work
I'd be happy to help, if you'll let me.
Good day to you. Looking for work?
I'm Luke. I'll do my very best to help.
Sorry, but I'm not looking for work.
Oh? Then are you here for an employer?
That's even better! Times are hard, so
everyone wants work. You're most welcome.
No, I merely dropped by.
Oh dear... I jumped to conclusions, did I?
My apologies. Still, do have a look around.
You might find a line of work you like.
Anyone in London is welcome here.
Do drop by again whenever you like.
Good day to you. Oh, it's you
So you were looking for work after all?
